interfaces: JSON envelope { schemaVersion, ok, command, data, error }

behavioralConstraints: JSON mode emits exactly one top-level envelope object for normal success or expected command failure
documented npm machine invocation suppresses npm lifecycle logging so stdout remains exactly one CLI envelope
invariants: identical argv and repository version produce deterministic normal shell results
shell behavior does not require an AI provider
registration of a reserved command never implies implemented workflow semantics
examples: npm run --silent agent -- --json version emits only a success envelope on stdout and exits 0
next exits 3 with COMMAND_NOT_IMPLEMENTED until BOOT-008
edgeCases: --json may appear before or after the command token

expectations: stable top-level envelope and documented exit-code meanings
registered reserved commands do not report success without implemented behavior
